title: pnpm check prints a three-line summary, and lint holds markdown line width
notes:
From the retro over the 10 worker sessions for #325-#333 (2026-11-18).
1. pnpm test | tail -5 ends on vitest's 'Isolate ... workers spawned' lines, so 5 sessions ran the whole suite twice to see the summary. Add a pnpm check script that runs test, typecheck and lint, writes the full output to a log file (path printed), and prints one summary line per check (pass/fail and counts). Point CLAUDE.md's Checks block and the work-card skill at it.
2. A review round on #331 went to rewrapping markdown lines twice. Add a markdown line-width check to pnpm lint, at the width the docs already use (measure it; pick the width nearly all of docs/ already meets, and fix the few lines over it in the same PR). Code blocks, tables and URLs are exempt.
